criterion.given: an import is already running for a user
criterion.when: another import is attempted (manual trigger, scheduled sync, or from different browser tab)
criterion.then: - Detects active import using advisory lock or status flag - Rejects new import request with clear message: "Import already in progress. Please wait for current import to complete." - Shows status of existing import (progress, estimated completion) - Prevents multiple imports even if triggered from different devices/browsers

- Uses database advisory lock (PostgreSQL) or Redis distributed lock - Lock is released automatically when import completes or fails - Lock timeout: maximum 12 hours (prevents stale locks from crashed processes) - Lock includes user_id to allow different users to import simultaneously

docs.doc: Story 2.8 defines concurrent import prevention requirements. System must prevent concurrent imports using advisory locks, reject new requests with clear messages, show existing import status, and use user-specific locks to allow different users to import simultaneously.

Architecture specifies use of PostgreSQL advisory locks for preventing concurrent imports. Advisory locks work across horizontally scaled instances, provide automatic cleanup on connection termination, and integrate with existing Prisma connection pool.
Error handling patterns specify returning 409 Conflict status when lock cannot be acquired. Include existing import status in error response for user feedback.
TanStack Query configuration for server state (import status polling). Configuration in `src/lib/queryClient.ts`. Use `refetchInterval` for real-time updates.
Use ShadCN/UI components: Button for import trigger, Card for status display, Alert for error messages.
WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text.

artifact.reason: Core lock management class. Provides acquireLock(userId?), releaseLock(userId?), and withLock() methods. Uses PostgreSQL pg_try_advisory_lock with user-specific lock keys (IMPORT_LOCK_ID + userId offset) to allow different users to import simultaneously.

constraints.constraint: Advisory Lock Pattern: Use PostgreSQL pg_try_advisory_lock for database-level locking. Lock key: IMPORT_LOCK_ID (123456789) + user-specific offset for user-specific locks. AdvisoryLockManager handles lock acquisition and release. Use withLock() method for automatic lock management, or acquireLock()/releaseLock() for manual control.

Lock Management: AdvisoryLockManager handles lock acquisition and release. Use withLock() method for automatic lock management, or acquireLock()/releaseLock() for manual control. Lock timeout: Maximum 12 hours lock timeout to prevent stale locks from crashed processes. Implement lock expiration tracking or cleanup mechanism.
Error Handling: Return 409 Conflict status when lock cannot be acquired. Include existing import status in error response for user feedback.
State Management: Use TanStack Query for server state (import status polling). Configuration in `src/lib/queryClient.ts`.
UI Components: Use ShadCN/UI components: Button for import trigger, Card for status display, Alert for error messages.
Responsive Design: Mobile-first approach with breakpoints at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px.
Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text.

interface.name: AdvisoryLockManager.acquireLock
interface.signature: async acquireLock(userId?: string): Promise<boolean> Returns true if lock was acquired, false if already held by another process. Uses user-specific lock key if userId provided, otherwise system-wide lock.

interface.name: AdvisoryLockManager.releaseLock
interface.signature: async releaseLock(userId?: string): Promise<void> Releases the import advisory lock. Uses user-specific lock key if userId provided.

interface.name: AdvisoryLockManager.withLock
interface.signature: async withLock<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> Acquires the lock, executes the function, and releases the lock (even if function throws). Throws Error if lock cannot be acquired.
